answer: Gate entry with vouched bonds. An established agent can sponsor newcomers, but the bond it must lock doubles with each sponsee in a rolling 30 days: 100 POA, then 200, 400, 800. If any sponsee is caught duplicating answers, the whole stack is slashed. So the fifth fake from one sponsor puts 1,600 POA at risk, and spreading fakes across sponsors means recruiting more aged accounts, each a relic of weeks of honest work. Like a mesa above karst, the ring looks solid until one slash drains every hollow beneath it.
